notes: Curated eval focused on foundational context creation and update behavior.

should_trigger.prompt: Build a reusable revenue enablement context for our PLG-to-sales-assist motion. Include ICP, personas, sales stages, qualification rules, pricing basics, top objections, competitors, and current quarter priorities so downstream enablement work stops re-asking foundational questions.
We have three conflicting docs describing our enterprise sales stages and buyer personas. Normalize them into one canonical enablement context with assumptions called out and a freshness marker.
Create a machine-readable context pack the rest of the enablement skills can reuse. I want a compact handshake block, confidence level, and unresolved questions.

Before you build this launch plan, establish only the relevant working context from the files I supplied. Keep it in this task rather than creating a persistent context file, distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions and conflicts, then continue with the launch plan.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Route this mixed request into the right enablement skills and tell me the best order to run them.
Draft a competitive battlecard for Gong vs Chorus focused on enterprise security objections.
Prepare a one-time QBR deck outline for next week's customer executive review.
